posts.text: I'm excited to share that I will be joining J.D. Power as a Software Developer Intern starting Summer 2026! I'm incredibly grateful for this opportunity and am looking forward to working, learning, and contributing alongside the amazing team at J.D. Power! Thank you to everyone who has supported me and helped me reach this milestone.

While other people spent their summer building web apps or interning at some big tech company, I decided to do something a little different. After seeing a funny Instagram reel of a Billy Bass toy talking about lifting iron, I thought, “I can build that.” Four months (and a couple of fried Raspberry Pis) later… I am proud to share BillyBassAI 🎉 - an AI-powered talking fish on a wall that you can actually chat with. 🛠️ How it works: 🤖 AI Brains: Google Gemini API for intelligent, contextual conve

I'm excited to share that I’ll be returning this summer as a Desktop Support Student at the County of Brant I’m grateful for the opportunity to continue building my IT skills and knowledge while gaining valuable hands-on experience in a supportive environment. I'm looking forward to working with the amazing team again this summer!

Here's a short demo video of the AI-powered checkout I implemented from the 2025 Overhaul hackathon! This feature includes: - Real time item detection -Automatic checkout updating - Easy to use UI This feature was built using TensorFlow.js and a Machine Learning Model trained on a small data set of generic grocery items. Project Link: https://lnkd.in/gRCsJy8h Great work by our team— Maximus Slabon,Julian Barua,Thea Ishida. AI Integration was a key aspect of our project — built in just under 36 h

After 36 intense hours of debugging, coding,problem-solving, and countless git commits my team and I are thrilled to have won first place at Western Developers Society's Overhaul 2025 hackathon Our team made a functioning prototype for an AI-powered checkout system that uses machine learning to automatically detect items and add them to the cart—offering an innovative, accessible, and user-friendly shopping experience. A massive shoutout to my awesome teammates Julian Barua,Thea Ishida and Maxim
